\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]

\item \textit{Notes:} $u^{(k)}$: series $u$ averaged over the previous $k$ intervals; $\bar a^{(k)}(u)$ and $\bar\chi^{(k)}(u)$: the same averages of its availability (missing-data) and activity indicators (Section~\ref{sec:rh_predictors} and Table~\ref{tab:rh_dm_dictionary}). Horizons: $k \in \{1, 5, 25, 125, 625, 3125\}$ in the closing-interval model and $k \in \{1, 2, 4, \dots, 2048\}$ in the pooled intraday model; activity indicators exist for the 7 series whose mode accounts for at least 20\% of intervals. In the closing-interval model, the twelve interactions of the HAR components with the opening- and closing-interval dummies are zero or copies of $\bar y^{(k)}$ and are omitted, and four of the 16 calendar dummies (hour, overnight, open, close) are constant and are dropped at every estimation. The pooled intraday panel predates the FOMC group (4 series) and has no FOMC predictors; with them it would have 1{,}264 columns. At every estimation, predictors constant within the rolling window or exact copies of another are dropped.
\end{tablenotes}
